name: Solitude
source: Kenzo lives alone and it seems he is not missing anything in his life. One day however, he comes back home and realizes someone has broken into his house... [From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=19009]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
健藏独自生活，似乎并不觉得人生缺少什么。然而某天回家后，他发现有人闯进了自己的住处……

[译自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=19009]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
